terminos_titulo: Terms and Conditions of Accounting and Tax Advisory Services
terminos_desc: Learn about the standards of professional practice, SOL key custody, deadlines, and legal guarantees that govern our accounting services.
vigencia_nota: Effective for Lima and online nationwide under the Peruvian Civil Code (Art. 1756) and Law N° 28951 of the Public Accountant.
clausula_1_desc: The accounting firm operates under the technical direction of CPA Lourdes Cusihuaman, Certified Public Accountant, former SUNAT officer with active Tax ID. All advisory adheres to Law N° 28951 and the Professional Code of Ethics.
clausula_2_tit: 2. Scope of Accounting and Tax Services
clausula_2_desc: We provide advisory in SUNAT tax regimes (RER, MYPE, General, Independent 4th Category), monthly tax liquidation (IGV - Income Tax), SIRE electronic records, PLAME payroll, and audit resolution.
clausula_3_desc: The client's SOL Key and secondary credentials are provided strictly for tax compliance under professional mandate. The firm guarantees absolute confidentiality and secure encrypted storage.
clausula_4_desc: The client agrees to deliver invoices, expense receipts, bank statements, and payroll data at least 3 to 5 business days before official SUNAT due dates according to their Tax ID (RUC) schedule.
clausula_5_desc: Accounting computations are based on documentation provided by the client. The taxpayer assumes legal responsibility for the veracity and legitimacy of their business transactions under the Peruvian Tax Code.
clausula_6_desc: Monthly or per-service fees are transparently agreed upon beforehand. An official electronic invoice or fee receipt is issued for every transaction in accordance with SUNAT regulations.
clausula_7_desc: We accept bank transfers, digital wallets (Yape, Plin), and cash at our office, in compliance with Legislative Decree N° 1529 (Peruvian Financial Transaction Law).
clausula_8_desc: All client accounting, financial, and corporate data is protected by professional privilege and statutory duty of confidentiality, surviving service termination.
clausula_9_desc: Services are provided in person at Jr. Dante 260, Surquillo (by appointment) and via digital channels (official WhatsApp +51 936 369 384, Google Meet, and email) during business hours.
clausula_10_desc: Contractual relations are governed by the laws of the Republic of Peru, specifically the Service Agreement provisions of the Civil Code. Any disputes shall be submitted to the courts of Lima, Peru.
